name: plugin-page-preview
description: Preview a WordPress.org plugin page from a local readme and assets.

scripts.test: node --test tests/browser-client.test.mjs tests/static.test.mjs tests/import.test.mjs tests/wordpress-version.test.mjs tests/github-preview.test.mjs
scripts.build:production: npm run build && node scripts/cloudflare-build.mjs production
scripts.build:preview: npm run build && node scripts/cloudflare-build.mjs preview
scripts.deploy: npm run build:production && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode production
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:preview && cf previews deploy --prebuilt --mode preview
